title: Verify rich-content parity and recovery
description: Verify nested rich content, mixed sizing, overflow, missing and offline assets, QR geometry, overlays, reload recovery, and normalized scene parity across preview and PDF adapters.
acceptanceCriteria: Contract fixtures cover nested row, column, stack, mixed sizing, overflow, and bounded or escaped overlays
Asset fixtures cover valid offline recovery, integrity mismatch, removal, unsupported type, and no network fallback
QR fixtures are deterministic and independently decode to their supplied payloads
A mixed label survives reload with an identical normalized content tree and printable scene
Preview and PDF adapter inputs normalize to the same scene geometry at multiple zooms and viewports
Focused Playwright coverage completes keyboard authoring through PDF generation
Build, lint, unit/integration, artifact, and focused browser checks pass without physical claims

steps.details: Create one mixed nested valid fixture and focused overflow, escaped-overlay, missing-asset, offline-asset, and invalid-QR fixtures with expected stable diagnostics.
Resolve each valid fixture once, feed the same scene to preview and PDF adapters, and compare node identities, geometry, resources, and diagnostics rather than screenshots alone.
Save the mixed project, reload offline, assert equivalent content and assets, then remove one asset and assert element-specific refusal with no external request.
Run build, lint, focused contracts/artifact tests, and Playwright keyboard flow; verify visible language makes no physical scale, placement, containment, or printing claim.

technicalNotes: Keep execution under ten minutes by using a compact canonical fixture matrix and focused test filters.
Digital parity and QR decoding do not prove physical print quality, alignment, or scan performance.
